بَوَّأَهُمْ مَنْزِلًا (AZ, M) and منزلًا ↓ أَبَآءَهُمْ (AZ, TA) also signify He alighted and abode with them by the face, or front, of a mountain, where it rose from its base, (AZ, M, TA,) or next to a river, or brook. (AZ, TA.) ＝
-A2- [Hence, (see بَآءَةِ,)] بوّأ (inf. n. تَبْوِيْءٌ, K) (assumed tropical:) Inivit [feminam]: and he married [a woman]; took [her] in marriage: syn.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
